entities.summary: Patrick Chauvel (b. 1949-04-07, 16th arrondissement of Paris) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in 16th arrondissement of Paris and France. Known in the fields of france, painters & sculptors, europe.
